verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs mention "scheduled imports" as a way to bring in data, which is a narrow form of recurring job. The Analyst Agent "continuously monitors" the business, but nothing describes user-defined schedules for general workflows or agent runs. missing for 10: user-configurable recurring workflow/job scheduling beyond imports, scheduling of agent tasks or reports, cron or frequency controls, in-depth docs and independent corroboration
